title: Finite submodules over a principal left-ideal ring
statement: Let $R$ be an associative ring with identity, not necessarily commutative. Suppose every left ideal $I$ of $R$ is principal: for some $g\in R$, $I=Rg=\{ag:a\in R\}$. Here a left ideal is an additive subgroup of $R$ stable under multiplication on the left by elements of $R$. If $P$ is any finitely generated left $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] and $K\subseteq P$ any left $R$-submodule, then $K$ is finitely generated as a left $R$-module.
